persistence: React state only; no build-specific storage path
exportShare: explicit local JSON download only; no URL share or server upload
securityBoundary: The classifier has no external tools, actions, network retrieval, or model-generated output. Dispositions remain product heuristics and cannot authorize deployment or removal by themselves.
support: Core path depends only on standard browser HTML/JS; Chromium and WebKit are covered by automated release testing; physical-device/manual acceptance remains separate.
warnings: Do not enter restricted or confidential information unless you are authorized to process it on the current device/browser.
AUTOMATE, KEEP HUMAN and REMOVE are discovery candidates, not binding operational decisions.
